about: Preview for the minimal OmniHuman trial (Jimeng 数字人 大师模式): research-2026-11-02.md. User direction: 「不行,太low了.我看了下这个对嘴,要不不用对的狠准,我们只需要让人物真的表现在唱歌就好」. Nothing is submitted before the user approves this preview.

audio.role: uploaded vocal (isolated), not TTS or a cloned voice; chorus pass 1 'I didn't run / I just looked outside'

mode: 即梦 数字人 · 大师模式 · 1080P · single subject (not 生动模式, which crops to 1:1)

OH-B.action_prompt: 镜头固定特写。她冷静但投入地对着镜头唱歌，嘴随歌词自然张合，乐句之间轻轻换气，肩膀随呼吸微微起伏，头随乐句轻轻点动，眉头舒展，眼神始终看着镜头。
OH-B.why: pure Chinese, positive, actions only (official template: camera + mood + speaking state + actions); 冷静但活着 as the user chose for v3

budget.estimate_basis: no official per-second price for 数字人; upper bound at the Seedance 2.0 VIP 1080p rate (~33 credits/s) x 5 s x 2
budget.rule: read the UI price and the balance before and after each submit; stop on any unknown outcome

placement: lag 0 at song 17.97 s (the audio starts at clip 0); S8a uses clip 0.897-4.597 s (film 18.867-22.567 s)
accept: both phrases visibly open and close
a breath is visible before 'I just'
no frown, no frozen face, no over-acting
identity matches K7, pane background stable
per-shot gate first, then the user watches it with the song
drop: K7 refused by the entry review: stop, no preprocessing to get past it
both takes repeat the frown / weak expression / frozen face, or show exaggerated mouth, broken teeth or identity drift: drop the route, no third take
